theme_and_archetype.description: A high-performance, authoritative operational dashboard. Clean, high-contrast, designed for rapid scanning and data clarity. Automotive undertones with sharp, technical accents.

headings.purpose: Used for page titles, major metrics, and section headers.

body.purpose: Used for data tables, form inputs, labels, and secondary text.

layout_and_spacing.container_strategy: Sidebar navigation (w-64) with a fixed top header (h-16) for breadcrumbs and user profile. Main content area fills the remaining viewport with overflow-y-auto.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Mode B: 'Control Room' Grid. Dense, data correlation. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-4 or gap-6.

surface_styles.dashboard_cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

component_rules.buttons: Flat colors. Primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white. Secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50. Ghost: text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100.
component_rules.tables: Dense layout. Header rows use subtle background (bg-slate-50) and uppercase tiny text. Body rows have 1px bottom border. Hover state on rows (hover:bg-slate-50/50).
component_rules.forms: Inputs use rounded-md, border-slate-300, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600/20 focus:border-blue-600. Labels must be bold and small.
component_rules.status_badges: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium. Use status background and text colors defined in color_palette.
component_rules.tabs: Shadcn tabs, overridden to be transparent background with an underline active state or segmented control style.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All clickable rows and cards MUST slightly lift (-translate-y-[1px]) or change background color smoothly (duration-200 ease-out).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade-in with a slight upward motion (translate-y-2 to 0, opacity 0 to 1) for main content area when switching sidebar routes.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use skeleton loaders matching the exact dimensions of widgets/tables instead of spinners.

icons.style: Regular or Duotone for sidebar, Fill for active states.

login_background.description: Abstract minimalist background for professional car rental dashboard login page.
login_background.placement: Used as the background image covering 50% of the screen on the login page (split layout) or as a full background with a glassmorphism card.

dashboard_texture.placement: Can be used as a very low opacity (5%) fixed background texture for the entire app, or specifically inside the top header to give it depth.

vehicle_placeholders.description: Front view of a stylish white SUV
vehicle_placeholders.placement: Used in the Vehicles list/grid as thumbnail placeholders for SUVs.

vehicle_placeholders.description: A sleek black sedan parked against a white wall.
vehicle_placeholders.placement: Used in the Vehicles list/grid as thumbnail placeholders for Sedans.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Especially white text on primary blue buttons.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, forms, links, buttons, table rows MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="vehicle-row-1"', 'data-testid="create-rental-button"').

domain_specific_instructions.language: All UI text, placeholders, labels, and error messages MUST be in Portuguese (PT-BR).
domain_specific_instructions.dashboard_widgets: Top metrics should include 'Total Veículos', 'Disponíveis', 'Aluguéis Ativos', 'Concluídos', and 'Receita'. Use a distinct visual weight for the 'North Star Metric' (e.g., Aluguéis Ativos).
domain_specific_instructions.rental_flow: The rental details should function as a split-view or full-page form clearly outlining the stages: Reserva -> Retirada -> Devolução (with calculation of final price and payment method). Use visual timeline/stepper for status.
